relevance_scale.0: not relevant (implicit for every unlisted passage)

annotation_policy: Judgment IDs use the corpus v1 one-chunk reference form document_id:0. The evaluator maps these to source passages, collapses multiple retrieved chunks to their source document, and ranks each passage once so alternate chunk-size sweeps remain comparable. Unlisted documents have grade 0. Queries and judgments are synthetic and intended to validate the evaluation pipeline, not support claims about production retrieval.
limitations: One query per narrow test intent/domain pair gives no statistical power.
Judgments are authored with the synthetic corpus and may favor its vocabulary.
No model was run to create these relevance labels.
